title: Basics
summary: UTF-8 for Python and no session cron jobs.
details: Sets two environment values: Python always uses UTF-8 (PYTHONUTF8=1), and Claude Code session cron jobs are turned off (CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_CRON=1). Useful if you run Python through Claude or do not want scheduled jobs inside sessions. It changes two keys in settings.json only; no code runs and no network is used.
risk: Two environment settings only. No code runs.
